subject.title: Clarify status of optional bird transport

question: Should new Birdclaw users be directed to `xurl` until a maintained Bird distribution is available, or is there another supported Bird installation source that should replace the deprecated npm package and unavailable repository?
rationale: Repository evidence shows both active Bird adapter maintenance and an unusable public installation path; only the project owner can determine whether that state is temporary, private, or intentional retirement.

options.title: Recommend xurl temporarily
options.body: Direct new users to `xurl` and describe Bird as compatibility for existing installations until a maintained public distribution returns.

options.title: Publish Bird install source
options.body: Provide the maintained Bird package or repository and retain the current dual-transport recommendation.

options.title: Retire Bird deliberately
options.body: Deprecate the adapter through an explicit migration and compatibility plan rather than leaving its status implicit.

recommendation.title: Recommend xurl temporarily
recommendation.body: Direct new users to `xurl` and describe Bird as compatibility for existing installations until a maintained public distribution returns.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored or merged the central guidance and implementation and own the package and repository namespace whose status must be clarified.
